title: TYPO3 v14 development: agent skills for TYPO3
description: Look up the v14 way before writing it, check TypoScript against its reference, build backend components with Lit, and run it all in DDEV. For each skill: the prompt you would type and what it does. Narrated, with selectable captions.
alt: Film, 88 seconds: TYPO3 v14 development, 4 agent skills for TYPO3 v14 (typo3-v14-reference, typo3-typoscript-ref, typo3-webcomponents, typo3-ddev). Each skill with its own prompt and what it delivers. Narrated, with selectable captions.

transcript.text: Agents still write TYPO3 code from old memory. These skills teach them version fourteen.
TYPO3 v14 development: four skills for TYPO3 v14.
Shows how v14 code is written: controllers, ViewFactory, PSR-14 events, TCA, QueryBuilder and CLI.
A version-aware reference for TypoScript, TSconfig and Fluid, with a local lookup.
TypoScript keys are easy to misremember.
Builds v14 backend Web Components with Lit, import maps and FormEngine integration.
It turns jQuery-era backend code into standard Web Components.
Starts and reaches a local TYPO3 instance with DDEV, for one version or several side by side.
Most other skills need a running instance to check their work.
Open source. Clone the skills, and help us improve them.
